planSteps.description: The search input field with id 'search-input' is visible on the page
Click the visualization type card with attribute data-type-id 'central-node-map'
The page displays the color palette selection grid with id 'paletteGrid'
Click the color palette button with attribute data-palette-id 'ocean-blue'
Click the 'Next: Style' button with id 'step2NextBtn'
The style section is visible containing connector, icon, and typography style options
Click the connector style button with data-style-type 'connector' and data-style-id 'curved'
Click the icon style button with data-style-type 'icon' and data-style-id 'outline'
Click the typography style button with data-style-type 'mood' and data-style-id 'corporate'
Click the button with text containing 'Generate Prompt'
The user content text area with id 'user-content' is visible on the page
Type 'Seattle Coffee Shop SWOT Analysis' into the textarea with id 'user-content'
The generated prompt textarea with id 'generated-prompt' contains the text 'Seattle Coffee Shop SWOT Analysis'
The character count span with id 'prompt-char-count' is visible and does not equal '0 characters'
